## Services

- Starlink installation — from $350. I mount the dish, run the cable clean, and make sure the Wi-Fi actually covers the house before I leave.
- Whole-property Wi-Fi and network support — dead-zone fixes, mesh systems, shop and barn coverage, and tech support after the install from a local person, not an app.
- Smart home and security — cameras, smart locks, thermostats, doorbells, and device setup.
- Handyman installs, upgrades, and repairs — ceiling fans, fixtures, mounting, assembly, and home repairs, priced up front from my published rate book. $150 job minimum, which includes the first 40 round-trip miles.
- Site assessments — a written report on a property's condition and network options, from $150.

## Service area

- Starlink installs: free within 20 miles of Pittsburg, TX; flat trip bands out to about 110 miles; farther trips are quoted up front before booking. I regularly serve East Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Oklahoma, including Tyler, Longview, Texarkana, Mt. Pleasant, and Shreveport.
- Handyman work: based in Pittsburg and serving Camp County and the surrounding area. My $150 job minimum includes the first 40 round-trip miles.
